flags.why: Dom denotes the terminal part of the large intestine at the anus, rather than the anal opening itself ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/dom)).
This sexual euphemism remains in ordinary contemporary use and should not be labelled rare ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/di-lai-eWrODfLtKfA5A.html)).
Giáp meaning to touch or adjoin is ordinary current Vietnamese, as in hai nhà giáp nhau ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/gi%C3%A1p)).
